name: backdrop-upload-simple
description: Simple ladder for the walk-mode window backdrop (backdrops + customBackdrop flags): confirms both are simple-tier (visible by default in Simple mode), opens the Scene menu's 'Window view (walk mode)' section, enters walk mode, cycles a preset (dusk), uploads a custom photo through the REAL file-input change handler (applyWalkBackdropFile), verifies it is selected + shows through the window, then asserts the guard rejects an oversize file and a non-image file via the same path.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); })()

steps.name: open-curtains
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.items.filter((i) => i.defId === 'curtains').forEach((i) => s.updateItemProps(i.id, { drawAmount: 0 })); })()
steps.failMessage: This opens the living/dining curtains (drawAmount:0) so the backdrop is actually visible through the glass — they default to drawAmount:1 (closed), which otherwise hides the backdrop entirely in every walk-mode shot below.

steps.name: verify-simple-mode
steps.failMessage: App did not boot in Simple mode

steps.name: verify-flags-simple-tier
steps.failMessage: backdrops/customBackdrop are supposed to be tier:'simple' and on by default — expected both true in Simple mode

steps.name: backdrop-select-visible
steps.failMessage: Backdrop combobox did not render — backdrops flag should show it in Simple mode

steps.name: upload-entry-visible
steps.failMessage: 'Upload photo…' entry missing — customBackdrop flag should show it in Simple mode

steps.name: reject-non-image
steps.eval: (async () => { const label = [...document.querySelectorAll('.scene-field')].find((el) => el.textContent.includes('Your photo')); const input = label.querySelector('input[type=file]'); const file = new File(['not an image'], 'notes.txt', { type: 'text/plain' }); const dt = new DataTransfer(); dt.items.add(file); const setFiles = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'files'); Object.defineProperty(input, 'files', { value: dt.files, configurable: true }); input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); })()

steps.name: reject-non-image-toast
steps.failMessage: Non-image upload should surface an error toast per applyWalkBackdropFile's 'Please choose an image file.' guard

steps.name: reject-oversize
steps.eval: (async () => { const label = [...document.querySelectorAll('.scene-field')].find((el) => el.textContent.includes('Your photo')); const input = label.querySelector('input[type=file]'); const big = new Uint8Array(26 * 1024 * 1024); const file = new File([big], 'huge.jpg', { type: 'image/jpeg' }); const dt = new DataTransfer(); dt.items.add(file); Object.defineProperty(input, 'files', { value: dt.files, configurable: true }); input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); })()

steps.name: reject-oversize-toast
steps.failMessage: Oversize upload (>25MB) should surface an error toast per applyWalkBackdropFile's 'too large' guard

steps.name: upload-real-photo
steps.eval: (async () => { const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = 512; c.height = 256; const g = c.getContext('2d'); const bands = ['#ff3b30', '#ff9500', '#ffcc00', '#34c759', '#007aff', '#5856d6']; const bw = c.width / bands.length; bands.forEach((clr, i) => { g.fillStyle = clr; g.fillRect(i * bw, 0, bw, c.height); }); g.fillStyle = '#ffffff'; g.font = 'bold 40px sans-serif'; g.fillText('CUSTOM BACKDROP', 40, 140); const blob = await new Promise((r) => c.toBlob(r, 'image/png')); const file = new File([blob], 'my-view.png', { type: 'image/png' }); const label = [...document.querySelectorAll('.scene-field')].find((el) => el.textContent.includes('Your photo')); const input = label.querySelector('input[type=file]'); const dt = new DataTransfer(); dt.items.add(file); Object.defineProperty(input, 'files', { value: dt.files, configurable: true }); input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); })()
